newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate down on strong peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate down on strong peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates were down 78 basis points at 17.65 percent in early trade on Monday.
Dealers said a strong peso encouraged rates to fall from high levels reached after a late spike on Friday.
"The market is closely linked to the peso's fortunes and that is what is happening today," a fixed-income analyst said.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts were meanwhile 0.6 of a centavo stronger at 7.7800/7.7830 per dollar.
Dealers said rates could rise once more in later trade, however, due to players withholding hefty liquidity positions in an effort to manipulate the market.
Overnight rates on bank paper declined 70 basis points to 18.85 percent.
Liquidity of 1.271 billion pesos was due to return to the system from prior central bank operations.
